name: Elspeth Tirel
description: Elspeth Tirel is a human planeswalker and knight, from Capenna and haunted by childhood captivity under the Phyrexians, who became an archangel during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

summary.text: Elspeth Tirel is a human planeswalker and knight, from Capenna and haunted by childhood captivity under the Phyrexians, who became an archangel during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

bio.text: As a child Elspeth and her mother were captured by Phyrexians, and just before vivisection her spark ignited and she planeswalked to Theros.

citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Alara she helped Rafiq kill Malfegor and then planeswalked away from Bant, and later on Mirrodin she was shamed out of cowardice by Vadi and fought the Phyrexians with Koth and Venser.

citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Theros she slew the hydra Polukranos and became Heliod's champion, led the army that broke the siege of Akros, and was blamed when Xenagos rose to godhood.

citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Under Xenagos's control she killed Daxos, then she killed Xenagos in Nyx, and Heliod murdered her with her own weapon.

bio.text: In the Underworld she escaped Ashiok's torment, defeated Calix and Heliod with the Shadowspear, and was granted life by Erebos.

bio.text: She then arrived on New Capenna searching for a home, worked with the Maestros while seeking information on the Phyrexians, and was branded the city's most dangerous criminal.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel detonates a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities to protect planes connected to New Phyrexia, potentially causing a Multiversal spark rupture.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel detonated a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel's spark ignites at thirteen.
timeline.quote: When she is 13, Elspeth Tirel 's Spark ignites

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod kills Elspeth Tirel in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Heliod kills Elspeth with her weapon.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth credits Akrasa's safety to those who put loyalty above glory.
timeline.quote: Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe.

citation.text: Guardians of Akrasa (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is knighted on Bant at a very young age.
timeline.quote: In three years she was knighted, younger than almost anyone.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth nurses the broken Ajani back to health.
timeline.quote: she nursed Ajani Goldmane back to health

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Grixis incursion Elspeth unleashes her full powers and revives her squire Aran.
timeline.quote: She cast aside all the rules of civil warfare that Bant cherished and unleashed her full powers, devastating her enemies and bringing Aran back to life.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth helps Rafiq kill Malfegor, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.
timeline.quote: she assisted Rafiq in killing Malfegor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bant forever changed, Elspeth planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: With a heavy heart, she planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Alaran Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights in gladiatorial pits in exile.
timeline.quote: she began fighting in gladiatorial pits, misusing her training as a knight to win.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth encases Venser's head in stone to force him to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes in Elspeth's care on Bant.
timeline.quote: Ajani woke up in the care of Elspeth Tirel on Bant

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malfegor is killed in Bant by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq.
timeline.quote: he attacked Bant, where he was killed by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The column argues planeswalkers need strong values and relationships to be kept in conflict, using Ajani, Bolas and Elspeth as examples.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel , for example, cares deeply about her adopted home of Bant

citation.text: "Planeswalking into Conflict". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Refugees heading to the Sun-Dappled Court hear that a warrior-mage at Tower Stele destroyed an army of the hellish invaders and expect her to slay Thraximundar.
timeline.quote: A warrior-mage decimated an entire army of the hellish invaders !

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Balmgivers from Topa reach the refugees with food and healers, and Elspeth's name is spoken as Bant's hope.
timeline.quote: That night, the name Elspeth was spoken around campfires and inside healing tents.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The boy tells a blacksmith's family that Elspeth threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds.
timeline.quote: "She threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds," the boy replied.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals himself as the boy, drops the illusion and flies off as Antoris is destroyed and Thraximundar sweeps toward Naya; Elspeth is not really dead but will trouble him no more in Alara.
timeline.quote: The dragon let his illusion of the little boy evaporate into the acrid air and resumed his natural shape.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth fights Elspeth in the Urborg pits; she tries to kill him on seeing the Phyrexian mark until Ajani stops her.
timeline.quote: She was stopped by the timely intervention of Ajani Goldmane who had come looking for Elspeth.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Gathering Forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Corrupted Harvester captures Venser and Koth, and Elspeth returns to help them escape.
timeline.quote: Venser and Koth fell quickly to a Corrupted Harvester and were dragged back to its lair near Ish Sah .

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Scarred". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel returns and Koth, a Vulshok native to Mirrodin, is introduced as planeswalkers involved in the story.
timeline.quote: a new planeswalker by the name of Koth is introduced, a Vulshok native to Mirrodin

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Oxidda Chain Venser disables a leveler, and in Koth's village Koth's compleated mother attacks them and they destroy her.
timeline.quote: she has become compleated and attempts to kill them

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadi threatens Elspeth for cowardice, then explains she must face her fears and end the Phyrexian threat.

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: Elspeth steps through, killing the Phyrexians and freeing Venser

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Koth and Venser free Melira from Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod has Daxos remove traces of other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war, rifts open to the Underworld, and Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod.
timeline.quote: He hated Heliod most of all, and in his rage, he neglected to keep a tight grip on the souls under his purview.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos places him beneath a boulder in the Underworld and gives Elspeth his gratitude and safe passage home.
timeline.quote: Erebos took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder in the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod's desire for praise brings him into savage conflict with Purphoros; Purphoros' blade falls and is taken by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: fell from the heavens and was taken by a frightened Elspeth

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod tries to burn Elspeth alive for her sword, fails, and makes her his champion, converting the blade into the spear Godsend.
timeline.quote: he saw fit to make her his "champion" and converted the weapon into a spear called Godsend .

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod blames Elspeth for Xenagos' apotheosis and tries unsuccessfully to kill her.
timeline.quote: Heliod was quick to blame Elspeth and once again tried to kill her, but failed.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth's battle with Xenagos in Nyx, Heliod takes Godsend and stabs her, murdering her while taunting her.
timeline.quote: taking Godsend away from her and stabbing her with it

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod gives Elspeth's corpse to Ajani Goldmane and departs.
timeline.quote: He gave her corpse to Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights Heliod at the borders of the Underworld and shatters his spear; Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder.
timeline.quote: chained Heliod into the Underworld beneath a giant boulder.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel kills Xenagos.
timeline.quote: God of Revels. Killed by Elspeth Tirel .

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Minor gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood during the siege of Akros and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
timeline.quote: In circumstances largely under mystery , Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani free Nylea in Nyx, and Elspeth slays Xenagos with an arrow Nylea struck.
timeline.quote: The pair freed her from her magical prison, restoring her true form

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea forgives Elspeth, but Heliod kills Elspeth with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Heliod killed Elspeth with her weapon, Godsend

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel arrives, witnesses Purphoros's sword being cast aside, claims it and departs.
timeline.quote: She claimed the sword for herself and later departed the plane.

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks from New Phyrexia to Theros, where snake priests of Pharika restore her strength.
timeline.quote: After planeswalking away from New Phyrexia , Elspeth finds herself on a vaguely familiar plane, Theros.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth kills a deadly hydra in a bitter battle, winning Heliod's notice.
timeline.quote: After a bitter battle, she emerges the victor.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod, noticing her feat, strives to make Elspeth his champion.
timeline.quote: Heliod, taking notice of her feat, now strives to make Elspeth his champion.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood through the forced worship of a Great Revel after the siege of Akros, and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
timeline.quote: Using the forced worhsip of mortal revelers, Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth throws her spear into Xenagos' chest, exploding the arrowhead Nylea shot into him and killing him.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers her life for Daxos; Erebos accepts and Heliod fatally wounds his former champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth offered her life in trade for her lover Daxos .

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
timeline.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's Shadowspear is acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shatters, and Erebos imprisons Heliod in the Underworld forever.
timeline.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks away with Calix, whose spark ignites.
timeline.quote: Elspeth planeswalked away, with Calix, whose spark ignited in the meantime, following her.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood and is killed by Elspeth, revealing that the gods are replaceable.
timeline.quote: Xenagos ascended to godhood and was killed by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fearing replacement, Heliod strikes Elspeth down and casts her into the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Fearful, he struck her down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's nightmares torment Elspeth; in one vision she seizes Heliod's spear Khrusor and a twisted version remains.
timeline.quote: in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear, Khrusor.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth awakens with the Shadowspear and heads for a hidden exit, gathering followers and claiming Heliod's spear is the fake.
timeline.quote: Her believers gave her weapon power, and simultaneously weakened Heliod.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys weaves Calix to pursue Elspeth; Elspeth defeats him repeatedly on her way to the exit.
timeline.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece: an agent of fate she called Calix .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod's spear shatters against the Shadowspear and the onlookers' belief makes Elspeth's lie true; Heliod yields.
timeline.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos places the defeated Heliod beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage back to the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a brief reunion with Daxos Elspeth planeswalks away, and Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
timeline.quote: a spark flared inside him, and he planeswalked after her

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a Great Revel following the siege of Akros, Xenagos ascended to godhood as god of revels, and Elspeth was scapegoated for Daxos's death and exiled.
timeline.quote: Xenagos held the position of the god of the revels, furthering the chaos and distrust of the established pantheon.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani arrived in Nyx, and Xenagos knocked Elspeth down.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and her friend Ajani arrived in Nyx to set Theros right again.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Deicide in Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth threw Godsend into Xenagos's chest, detonating Nylea's arrowhead and killing him in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Deicide in Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege; the victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god.
timeline.quote: the victory celebration after the battle became the ultimate ritual to launch Xenagos into Nyx as a god.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is blamed for Xenagos's ascension and driven into the wilderness, vanishing in disgrace.
timeline.quote: Elspeth was blamed for his ascension and driven into the wilderness.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god; Elspeth is blamed and driven away.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is blamed for his ascension and driven away in disgrace.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth announces that a god has been slain.
timeline.quote: "It is done."

citation.text: Deicide (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fears her trespass into Nyx will not go unanswered.
timeline.quote: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

citation.text: Worst Fears (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos travel to Akros, where Xenagos tells her how to destroy the army by raising the river.
timeline.quote: they raised the river that ran through Akros and swept the army away

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Daxos and Elspeth realize their feelings after the victory celebration.
timeline.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realized their feelings for each other

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth, who kills Daxos while lashing out at the Phyrexian Obliterator in her memory.
timeline.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Callaphe is revealed to be the planeswalker Kiora.
timeline.quote: Callaphe revealed that her identity was a falsehood and that she was in truth the merfolk planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth smashes the false-life goblet and passes Erebos's ordeal.
timeline.quote: Though it broke her heart, she smashed the cup and passed Erebos's ordeal.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Nyx Elspeth strikes down Xenagos.
timeline.quote: They confronted Xenagos and battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod fatally wounds Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: using her weapon fatally wounded Elspeth

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Supported by Ajani, Elspeth travels to Nyx and kills Xenagos.
timeline.quote: Supported by Ajani , Elspeth travels to Nyx and kills Xenagos .

citation.text: "Journey into Nyx", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Afraid of her power, Heliod kills Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Afraid of her power, Heliod kills Elspeth.

citation.text: "Journey into Nyx", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Posing as the mariner Callaphe, Kiora is hired by Ajani and Elspeth to take them to the Temple of Mystery.
timeline.quote: One such facade she adopted was that of Callaphe

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora leads them to Arixmethes, a kraken, and Thassa refuses to let Kiora take it while helping Elspeth and Ajani.
timeline.quote: a massive kraken upon whom a city had been built

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
timeline.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
timeline.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
timeline.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Brimaz for help finding his friend Elspeth, and Brimaz points him to Lanathos.
timeline.quote: You should talk to Lanathos," said Brimaz.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani introduces himself to Lanathos and asks about Elspeth; Lanathos eagerly asks where Ajani is from.
timeline.quote: There are people across the mountains? Leonin and human?

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani resolves to find Elspeth and help her.
timeline.quote: After all, the Champion always has companions.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaps onto the back of Arixmethes and reveals to Ajani and Elspeth that she is not Callaphe, then leaves them to the Monsoon.
timeline.quote: "Not even close," Kiora replied, smiling back at him.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.
timeline.quote: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.

citation.text: Commune with the Gods (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is dead.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
timeline.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Elspeth records that partisans unearthed a strange artifact giving them hope.
timeline.quote: The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact.

citation.text: Unwinding Clock (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the realm the group meets the two sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless Bolas seeks a chance to regain power.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and casts a spell to reshape the realm; unable to sustain it, he shatters like glass as reality unmakes.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reach the Meditation Plane through an Omenpath and meet Narset and Elspeth.
timeline.quote: they were met by Narset and Elspeth Tirel who had followed a lead to find a solution to the increasing dragonstorms

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth attacks Bolas, thinking Jace will offer him the Gem, and Vraska tries to hold Jace back.
timeline.quote: Thinking that he would offer the Gem to Bolas, Elspeth attacked and temporarily distracted him.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The memory of Daxos's death wounds Elspeth.
timeline.quote: The sharp memory of Daxos's death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.

citation.text: Agonizing Remorse (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Calix patiently follows Elspeth until their destined confrontation.
timeline.quote: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

citation.text: Relentless Pursuit (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashiok savors Elspeth's twisted dreams and learns of the Phyrexians, then is speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: After being speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear , Ashiok planeswalked away

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth drowns in the Underworld until her spark reignites.
timeline.quote: She drowned until her spark reignited in a blinding light.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into Shadowspear.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled Heliod's spear, Khrusor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yields and Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The God of the Sun was forced to yield and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys, livid at souls reversing their deaths, dispatches Agents of Fate and creates Calix to deal with Elspeth's soul.
timeline.quote: For this task, Klothys created Calix .

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix and his oracle observed Xenagos's defeat by Elspeth and Ajani and Heliod's later betrayal of Elspeth.
timeline.quote: He and his oracle observed the defeat of Xenagos by Elspeth and Ajani

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas.
timeline.quote: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas .

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys learns Elspeth has escaped the Underworld and sends someone to bring her back or capture her.
timeline.quote: Klothys finds out about Elspeth escaping the Underworld so she is sending someone to bring her back to the Underworld or capture her.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel defeats Heliod and escapes the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel defeats Heliod and escapes the Underworld .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs the Sylex and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth grabs it before it can trigger fully and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
timeline.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
timeline.quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
timeline.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth survives by taking odd jobs in New Capenna, still feeling the hollow left by Godsend.
timeline.quote: She kept her head down and took odd jobs throughout the city as she could find them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "You're alive!" Ajani raced to her.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
timeline.quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.
